name: resistance band pull through
description: A hip hinge where you pull a band through your legs. Teaches the hinge and strengthens the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Anchor the band low and face away from it, holding the band between your legs.
Step forward until you feel tension, feet shoulder-width apart.
Push your hips back with a flat back.
Squeeze your glutes and drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Keep your arms relaxed and straight.
